summary: Reviewed the frozen 6764ad2..015b424 change set read-only; confirmed all 22 embedded post-change files match the snapshot and all 129 changed circuit semantic bodies are unchanged. Rubric method 1: derived binary16 1+2^-11 -> even 1 with inexact, half-minimum/2 -> zero or upward minimum with flags 24, directed overflow, invalid sqrt, fused (nearest 0.1)*10-1 -> 2^-54, and tanh(78) downward -> 0x3bff; all nine value/flag cases pass. Reproduced ISA inc8 at B=3/2/0 with steps 3/2/0 and codes 0/1/1, the lifted wrapper at B=5/4 and stack=7/6 with expected success/step/depth faults, and the exact LF envelope hash 8ce5e64f...6d5be93. Method 2: traced the complete lifted call/ret inverse lists (argument capture, seven-cell record, counter restoration, delivery, slot clearing) and nested R call/ret/uncall history with clock.read; two 256-case prefix checks pass and nested reversal equals entry. These executor probes check the consumer contract, not an arith-owned VM. Method 3: no repository-owned SPEC-QUESTIONS file; inspected the documented PPC, approximation and certificate compatibility readings and the actual pins. Method 4: classified grep hits: seven __builtin_trap sites guard invalid API parameters or impossible operation dispatch; approximation hits describe the versioned libm and independent sqrt comments; unsupported-op in the independent simulator fails loudly; license hits are irrelevant. No todo!/unimplemented!/unwrap/expect/panic/unreachable implementation stubs were found. Method 5: compared the applicable seven-format §13 carrier rows, wide conversions, pair order, rounding modes and flags with generators/dispatch and publication exports; all 1,141 literal names/signatures are preserved on each major. CC/R, launch and scheduler implementations belong to dependencies. Additional checks: 11,970 directed IEEE calls, 12 PPC parity/flag cases, phase invariants, 112 named-overflow APFloat source comparisons, four focused circuit/CLI tests and 48 oversized/negative modular-constant oracle cases pass. Both publications' hashes, source provenance and integer-only exports match; a scratch LLVM18 rebuild is byte-identical. All 129 raw circuit checks fail at token_aliases, with a same-reader base-pass/head-fail witness for an ordinary one-bit adder. Core verdict accepts the reviewed arithmetic changes against the supplied semantic context; whole-crate verdict revises for SOL-R1-S0-1.
